scene_description: A flat stone brick platform (17x17) with 6 freestanding columns of different colored stained glass scattered around the area. The target is a cyan stained glass column (3 blocks tall) at position ~6 ~0 ~6. Distractors include red, yellow, blue, lime, orange, and magenta stained glass columns to test the agent's ability to correctly identify cyan among similar colors.
task_text: Find the cyan stained glass block in the area. There are several colored glass columns scattered around — locate the cyan one.
design_notes: All glass columns are 3 blocks tall and freestanding on the stone brick platform with no obstructions. The cyan glass is at ~6,0,6 (southeast corner). Blue glass at ~3,0,-5 serves as the primary distractor since cyan and blue can appear similar. The platform is 17x17 blocks, easily navigable within 20 steps. The 'find' task requires the agent to get close enough to the cyan glass to have it in their field of view.
